mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_task (task_no, scope_type, scope_value, initiator_id, status) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeValue}, #{initiatorId}, #{status})

INSERT INTO inventory_item (task_id, archive_document_id, employee_id, department_id, expected_version_id) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{archiveDocumentId}, #{employeeId}, #{departmentId}, #{expectedVersionId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_no, scope_type, scope_value, initiator_id, status, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM inventory_task t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory_item i WHERE i.task_id = t.id AND ( #{scopeType} = 'ALL' OR (#{scopeType} = 'DEPARTMENT' AND i.department_id = #{departmentId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'EMPLOYEE' AND i.employee_id = #{employeeId}) ) )

SELECT id, task_id, archive_document_id, employee_id, department_id, expected_version_id, actual_version_id, actual_status, difference_type, difference_description, checked_by, checked_at FROM inventory_item WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND ( #{scopeType} = 'ALL' OR (#{scopeType} = 'DEPARTMENT' AND department_id = #{departmentId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'EMPLOYEE' AND employee_id = #{employeeId}) ) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, task_id, archive_document_id, employee_id, department_id, expected_version_id, actual_version_id, actual_status, difference_type, difference_description, checked_by, checked_at FROM inventory_item WHERE id = #{id} AND ( #{scopeType} = 'ALL' OR (#{scopeType} = 'DEPARTMENT' AND department_id = #{departmentId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'EMPLOYEE' AND employee_id = #{employeeId}) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_item WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_item WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND ( #{scopeType} = 'ALL' OR (#{scopeType} = 'DEPARTMENT' AND department_id = #{departmentId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'EMPLOYEE' AND employee_id = #{employeeId}) )
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_item SET actual_version_id = #{actualVersionId}, actual_status = #{actualStatus}, difference_type = #{differenceType}, difference_description = #{differenceDescription}, checked_by = #{checkedBy}, checked_at = #{checkedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND checked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_resolution (task_id, operator_id, resolution, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{operatorId}, #{resolution}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, operator_id, resolution, created_at FROM inventory_resolution WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, detail_json) VALUES (#{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{detailJson})
